name: rowsend
description: Draft and test marketing email for contacts in your own database, from a local desktop app.
long_description: Connects to the Rowsend desktop app running on your computer. Agents can connect your database, write campaigns in your brand, preview them and send you a test. Sending stays a button in the app, and keys never pass through MCP. Needs Rowsend installed in Applications. The first time this connects, Rowsend asks you to allow it.
